output.reason: [ev-5a31c0781dc5] and [ev-1295567312b0] say the `istiod-remote` Helm chart was merged into the regular `istio-discovery` chart. Installs move from `helm install istiod-remote istio/istiod-remote` to `istio/istiod --set profile=remote`. Neither source mentions a `global.profile` key, a value named `istiod-remote`, or a replacement value `istio`. So the proposed helm-value subject and its removal/replacement are misreadings. The change is a chart-level install step that remote-cluster operators have to perform, which fits the migration family with the migration-required change type.

correction.statement: The istiod-remote Helm chart has been merged into the istio-discovery chart. Clusters with a remote/external control plane must now be installed with istio/istiod and --set profile=remote instead of istio/istiod-remote.
